name: Die of Death Modded
desc:
[MODDED GAME] CREDITS TO THEBOSS

"Waiter! Waiter! More retro asymmetrical horror games!"

Game i made for fun to mock the current asymmetrical scenario, inspired by Forsaken and games on the same genre! In this game the survivors get 3 random decks with 2 abilities in each, this game is very chaotic and i recommend playing it with friends!

THE GAME IS IN A VERY EARLY PHASE! EXPECT IT TO GET CHANGES IN THE FUTURE!

Thumbnail art made by @acutiatr and @Roxlodez, @spiderzpi, @b_qel, and @validxz
